module: P7170 IP System Portable Two-Way FM Radios
description: The P7170 IP is M/A COM's premier portable radio for critical communications. Guided by customer feedback, M/A COM designed the P7170 IP to excel in the challenging environments that critical communications users encounter. The P7170 IP provides a superior combination of features, functions, and physical attributes. It is light and extremely durable, easy to use while wearing gloves, and produces loud and clear audio. A rugged high-tier portable, the P7170 IP provides exceptional performance even under adverse conditions.
